episodes.title: The H Word
episodes.summary: Matt, Jessica, Luke, and Danny try to get on with their lives. But the Hand has plans for New York City and won't tolerate interference.

episodes.title: Mean Right Hook
episodes.summary: While tracking the people responsible for the tremor, Danny meets Luke and Matt meets Jessica. Meanwhile, the Hand finds a wall blocking their way but Alexandra realizes that it's door... and she knows where to find the key.

episodes.title: Worst Behavior
episodes.summary: The four individual heroes all arrive at Midland Circle by different means, and Matt finds an old lover waiting for him.

episodes.title: Royal Dragon
episodes.summary: The team takes refuge in a Chinese restaurant to regroup and exchange notes, but first Stick and then Alexandra find them.

episodes.title: Take Shelter
episodes.summary: After one of their number is captured, three of the other Hand leaders consider if they are on the right path. Meanwhile, the team brings in their friends and loved ones to keep them safe from the Hand's retribution.

episodes.title: Ashes, Ashes
episodes.summary: The team captures Danny to keep him safe, but Stick has other plans. Meanwhile, Elektra begins to remember her past, and Alexandra tries to quell a rebellion within the Hand's ranks.

episodes.title: Fish in the Jailhouse
episodes.summary: The police hold Matt, Luke, and Jessica for questioning in the deaths of Stick and Sowande. Meanwhile, Elektra gives Danny the choice to help her freely in opening the wall.

episodes.title: The Defenders
episodes.summary: The heroes assault Midland to rescue Danny and stop the Hand... but one of them will fall.
